{{Quote|He's loose, but you'll find him. The Quarren's ship was overdue on docking fees, so I had Lorrb put an impoundment transmitter on it. The frequency's in his droid's memory.|Darial Anglethorn|<ref name="Blood" />}}
'''Lorrb''' was an individual who worked in a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Beheboth]]<ref name="Blood" /> by around [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040603beheboth1|series=Beheboth: Blood and Water|text=Part 1: Return to Prosperity}} dates the events of ''[[Beheboth: Blood and Water]]'' to a few [[Standard month|months]] after the [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|wedding]] of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. As ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the wedding to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], ''Beheboth: Blood and Water''&mdash;which includes [[Beheboth: Blood and Water|''Hit and Mist'']]&mdash;must also take place around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> Due to the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Kimp Minmirn]] not paying his [[Hangar/Legends|docking]] [[Currency/Legends|fees]], the [[Peacekeeper (Prosperity)|Peacekeeper]] [[Darial Anglethorn]] ordered Lorrb to place an [[impoundment transmitter]] in his [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. When [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mils Giel]] later fled the planet after being caught mutating the planet's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Tirrith]] population into his personal [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] force, he stole the Quarran's ship with Minmirn's assistance to make his escape. Lorrb had stored the transmitter's frequency in his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and, as Giel was unaware of the tracking device, the Beheboth [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] planned to use the device to follow the criminal.<ref name="Blood" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lorrb was mentioned in part four of ''[[Beheboth: Blood and Water]]'', [[Beheboth: Blood and Water|''Hit and Mist'']], a supplement to the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]]. The [[Planet Hoppers]] serial article was written by [[Cory J. Herndon]] and released on [[June 24]], [[2004]].<ref name="Blood" />
